# sapintegrationsuite_service_endpoints (Data Source)

Discovers the runtime service endpoints SAP exposes for deployed Cloud Integration content (the public ServiceEndpoints OData V2 API). This is discovery only: service endpoints are generated by SAP the moment matching content is deployed and disappear when it is undeployed, so there is no corresponding Terraform resource — the desired state that produces an endpoint lives in sapintegrationsuite_integration_flow / sapintegrationsuite_integration_flow_deployment (or the equivalent for other artifact types). This data source never invokes a discovered endpoint URL, downloads a referenced API definition document, or changes any runtime state; it only reads metadata. name and protocol are optional filters applied server-side via SAP's documented `Name eq '...'`/`Protocol eq '...'` OData $filter; leaving both unset returns every visible service endpoint. Every page SAP returns is fetched, and the result is sorted deterministically (by name, then protocol, with each endpoint's entry_points/api_definitions sorted too), since SAP does not document a guaranteed response order. See docs/guides/service-endpoints.md.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sapintegrationsuite_integration_flow_deployment" "orders" {
  package_id = sapintegrationsuite_integration_package.utilities.id
  flow_id    = sapintegrationsuite_integration_flow.orders.id
  version    = sapintegrationsuite_integration_flow.orders.version
}

# Every visible service endpoint, unfiltered.
data "sapintegrationsuite_service_endpoints" "all" {}

# Only the endpoint(s) generated for one specific deployed integration flow.
# depends_on is required here: this data source has no way to know it should
# wait for the deployment above, since service endpoints are discovered by
# name, not by a Terraform reference to the deployment resource itself.
data "sapintegrationsuite_service_endpoints" "orders" {
  name = "Order API"

  depends_on = [
    sapintegrationsuite_integration_flow_deployment.orders,
  ]
}

# Only SOAP endpoints, across every deployed artifact.
data "sapintegrationsuite_service_endpoints" "soap" {
  protocol = "SOAP"
}

output "order_api_entry_point_urls" {
  value = [
    for endpoint in data.sapintegrationsuite_service_endpoints.orders.endpoints :
    [for entry_point in endpoint.entry_points : entry_point.url]
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Only return service endpoints for the integration artifact with this exact name (SAP's documented `Name eq '...'` filter).
- `protocol` (String) Only return service endpoints with this exact protocol, as SAP reports it (for example "SOAP", "ODATAV2", "AS2", "AS4", "REST" — SAP's documented `Protocol eq '...'` filter). This provider does not reverse-map protocol values to adapter types; it exposes exactly what SAP returns.

### Read-Only

- `endpoints` (Attributes List) Every service endpoint matching the optional name/protocol filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints))

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints`

Read-Only:

- `api_definitions` (Attributes List) Links to machine-readable API definition documents for this endpoint (OpenAPI, EDMX, WSDL, and similar). This provider never downloads the document at url — only the link itself is returned. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints--api_definitions))
- `entry_points` (Attributes List) Runtime URLs exposed for this endpoint. SAP documents entry point Name/url as required and type as optional. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--endpoints--entry_points))
- `name` (String) The integration artifact's name this endpoint belongs to.
- `protocol` (String) The endpoint's protocol, exactly as SAP returns it.

<a id="nestedatt--endpoints--api_definitions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints.api_definitions`

Read-Only:

- `type` (String) The API definition's format: one of "oas-yaml", "oas-json", "raml", "edmx", or "wsdl", as SAP currently documents them.
- `url` (String) The fully qualified URL to the API definition document.


<a id="nestedatt--endpoints--entry_points"></a>
### Nested Schema for `endpoints.entry_points`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) The entry point's name.
- `type` (String) The entry point's environment, when SAP reports one: "DEV", "TEST", "PROD", or "SANDBOX".
- `url` (String) The fully qualified entry point URL or base path.
